steps: Clear the tutorial, then start Silent Meadows (level 1).
Gather resources, build towers, find 2 light sanctuaries, and destroy the enemy castle to win the level.
Start Stony Grove (level 2).
Expand your factory, defend waves, locate the light sanctuaries, and destroy the enemy castle.
Start Deciduous Pathways (level 3).
Scale production and tower coverage through denser terrain, then destroy the enemy castle.
Start Wanderer's Glade (level 4).
Keep your factory upgraded through harder nights and destroy the enemy castle to win.
Unlock and start Winter Plateau (level 5).
Bring strong meta-progression upgrades, hold late nights, and destroy the enemy castle.
Unlock and start Stormswept Gorge (level 6).
Use late-game towers and boss unlocks, then destroy the enemy castle to clear the map.
Earn gold coins by clearing nights (+1) and winning levels (+2).
Open the permanent upgrade menu and spend 20 gold coins to unlock Tier 2 — new structures such as the saw launcher and bombard become available.
Play normal levels and keep towers covering mushroom spawns.
Kill mushrooms across runs until the cumulative counter reaches 2500.

achievements.name: The creation of Light
achievements.description: Create Light Essence in the Light Cruicible

steps: Unlock and place a Light Crucible (Steam spelling: Cruicible) in your factory.
Feed it the required inputs so it produces Light Essence once.
Produce Light Crystals through your light/factory chain.
Keep producing until you have at least 5 Light Crystals stored at the same time.
Scale Light Crucible production and storage capacity.
Stockpile Light Essence until you hold 1500 at once.
Manually click resource nodes on the map to harvest them.
Accumulate 10,000 clicks across runs — quiet build phases are a good time to click.

achievements.name: Greedy
achievements.description: Have 3000 of the same resource stored

steps: Pick one common resource and prioritize its production and storage.
Hold 3000 units of that same resource at once.

achievements.name: Hard work
achievements.description: Have 3 Workshops working at the same time

steps: Build at least three Workshop buildings in your factory.
Supply all three so they are actively working at the same moment.

achievements.name: Not without my obelisks!
achievements.description: Have 16 towers affected by any Obelisk

steps: Unlock Obelisks and place them so their aura covers as many towers as possible.
Build or reposition towers inside Obelisk ranges until 16 towers are affected at once.
Play Silent Meadows (level 1) — the Totemic Mushroom spawns on night 6 with a large pack of bats, mushrooms, and crabs.
Raise tower capacity to ~30–35 and prioritize fiery catapults, explosive ballistas, and sticky-acorn cannons for slow.
Focus fire the boss until it dies (optional for winning the level — you can return later with more meta upgrades).
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Boss kills grant upgrades claimed from the level-select screen — go back after a boss kill so you do not miss the reward.
warnings: You can win Silent Meadows without killing the boss — return to the level if you skip it early.

steps: Play Stony Grove (level 2) and survive until the Orc King boss wave.
Stack AoE towers and slows, then focus the Orc King until it dies.
Return to level select afterward to claim the boss unlock reward.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Boss upgrades show up on the level-select screen — check back after a kill.

steps: Play Deciduous Pathways (level 3) and hold until the Fairy Bee boss appears.
Bring strong meta upgrades from earlier bosses, cover chokepoints, and burn the Fairy Bee down.
Claim the boss reward from level select after the fight.

achievements.name: Supreme Archmagus of the Naga
achievements.description: Defeat the Supreme Archmagus of the Naga

steps: Play Wanderer's Glade (level 4) until the Supreme Archmagus of the Naga spawns.
Use dense tower fields and prior boss unlocks to survive the pack, then focus the Archmagus.
Return to level select for the unlock reward.
Play Winter Plateau (level 5) until Emperor Frostbeak appears.
Bring late-game tower upgrades and keep production online through the boss night, then kill Frostbeak.
Claim the boss upgrade from the level-select screen.
communityNotes: Reddit tip: Later bosses (around level 5–6) may be required before attempting the final map.

achievements.name: Pontiff of the Blizzard
achievements.description: Defeat the Pontiff of the Blizzard

steps: Play Stormswept Gorge (level 6) with full meta progression and earlier boss unlocks.
Survive until the Pontiff of the Blizzard spawns, then focus it down with your strongest tower synergies.
Claim the final boss reward from level select.
